name: SURVIVE THE JOB APPLICATION
desc:
⚠️ Exploiting is strictly prohibited, and you will be permanently banned if caught. Please don't do it, it's not worth it!
⏳ Time is saved between sessions as long as you don't die. Feel free to leave at any time!
🕹️ Paychecks and XP are rewarded just by playing the game and surviving events. 💸

🎮 KEYBINDS & CONTROLS
ShiftLock: [LeftShift] / [R3]
Perspective: [Scroll] / [R3 Hold]
Flashlight: [F] / [D-Pad Right]
Emotes: [G] / [D-Pad Down]
